WITH media_type_averages AS (
  SELECT
    m.Name AS media_type_name,
    AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond
  FROM Track AS t
  JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804
  GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_of_media_type_averages
  FROM media_type_averages
)
SELECT
  media_type_name,
  average_bytes_per_millisecond,
  average_bytes_per_millisecond - average_of_media_type_averages AS above_overall_average
FROM media_type_averages
CROSS JOIN overall_average
WHERE average_bytes_per_millisecond > average_of_media_type_averages;
